QuestInfo.name: The Greatest Loss
QuestInfo.0: Your investigation reveals that the Lion King's Castle has changed in the last few centuries.
QuestInfo.1: Your investigation reveals that the Lion King's Castle has changed in the last few centuries.
QuestInfo.2: Not even his minions are safe from the Black Mage. You must stop him before he destroys everything.

0.0: Von Leon the Lion King is no servant of the Black Mage, not anymore. He's naught but a man with a hole torn in his heart and soul.
0.1: Perhaps this news will set Vieren at ease.

1.0: Well? How's our old pal Von Leon holding up?\r\n#L0##bHe's no pawn of the Black Mage. He's paralyzed by the loss of his love.#l\n#k
1.1: Poor fella. We should pay him a visit and cheer him up sometime. Do you know if he likes fruitcake?
